Only `user_service.cpp` was touched — unrelated to `test_003`'s correlation_id propagation check (a separate, pre-existing issue outside this task's scope), so that failure isn't something my change introduced.

The dry-run bug is fixed: `UserService::process_transaction` in `src/service/user_service.cpp` now sets `options.dry_run = dry_run` before calling `tx_manager_.execute()`, instead of leaving it at the default `false`. Verified via `validate_004.py`, which compiles and confirms dry-run transactions are no longer committed while still recording the correct flag, and non-dry-run commits remain intact (the `DatabaseClient::write_transaction` commit-skip logic was already correct — it just never received the true flag). Note: `test_003`/`validate_003.py` fails on an unrelated pre-existing correlation_id issue, untouched by this change.
